calculation_limits: The paper reports one vertical stiffness fit at 4.75 bar; it does not provide a complete pressure-dependent vertical stiffness curve.
The pressure scaling used by the application is a first-order proportional assumption and is not a measured property of every Schwalbe tire.
The contact patch dimensions are approximate digitizations of a raster figure and are retained for provenance, not used as a hidden manufacturer-specific calibration.
The reference tire and test bench are not the selected Schwalbe product. The result must be labelled as a generic reference model.
